blocks.text: The alternative hypothesis states that there is an effect or difference. It is written as opposite of the null hypothesis. It is represented by H₁ or Ha. The goal of testing is often to support this hypothesis. Evidence must be strong to accept it. It represents change or impact. Alternative hypotheses guide research direction. They explain expected outcomes. Testing compares both hypotheses.
Research Question: Does the amount of study time affect students' exam scores?
H₀ (Null Hypothesis): There is no significant relationship between study time and exam scores.
H₁ (Alternative Hypothesis): The amount of study time significantly affects students' exam scores.
